Evidence needed: case report/document from the 2010s describing a case with those symptoms and stating the diagnosis/reported disorder as stiff person syndrome. But avoid specific website. Sufficient evidence signature: a source that identifies the specific 2010s case and explicitly states the disorder diagnosed/reported.

Evidence_needed: A case report or clinical record from the 2010s describing a patient with six months of worsening multi-site body pain and difficulty walking/moving shoulders, explicitly identifying the diagnosed or reported disorder as stiff person syndrome. Or if the case report exists, exact statement of diagnosis. Should we mention "or evidence establishing the case's reported diagnosis"? Yes.
